 ICICI Securities research report on South Indian Bank 
 Closing Q2 on a strong note, South Indian Bank (SIB) delivered a fitting finale to Mr. Seshadri’s tenure as MD&CEO – loan growth now ahead of system and net NPA at amongst industry best, alongside a >50bps YoY NIM rise. Despite net NPA compressing ~17bps QoQ, RoA inched higher to 1.12%. SIB, under new MD&CEO, guides for strong loan growth (15-16% YoY; even higher in gold / MSME) and positive bias on NIM. Our downgrade (link), earlier, was basis management transition and we continue to monitor the new MD&CEO, Mr. Mahesh Pai’s, broad vision and execution. However, we also note SIB’s strong foundation in terms of growth (gold/MSME), net NPA (now lowest), ECL preparedness and tailwinds from hardening rate cycle.
 Outlook 
 We raise our target multiple to ~1.15x (~0.8x), in line with forward RoA, with a revised TP of INR 63 (vs INR 45).
